coded.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
coded.vl: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
coded.n: Recruiting agents must register and furnish a bank guarantee that can be forfeited; no joint liability with the employer.

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
coded.vl: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
coded.n: Service charges are capped by the Rules (at present ₹30,000 including tax); no cap applies to emigrants who do not need emigration clearance.

coded.vi: Kontrak wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori pekerja, atau tanpa syarat minimum atau verifikasi
coded.vl: A contract is required, but only for some categories of workers, or without minimum terms or verification
coded.n: Clearance requires a contract only for holders of ECR passports going to the 18 listed countries; other workers emigrate without state review of the contract.
Pre-departure orientation (PDOT) is offered but is not a condition of emigration.

coded.vi: Cakupan terbatas pada sebagian kategori pekerja atau sebagian risiko
coded.vl: Coverage is limited to some categories of workers or to some of these risks
coded.n: The Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana is compulsory only for ECR workers (death and permanent disability up to ₹10 lakh, repatriation, legal expenses); the Indian Community Welfare Fund at missions rests on guidelines.

coded.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vi: Atase ditempatkan berdasarkan keputusan administratif atau kebijakan, tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Officers are posted by administrative decision or policy, without a statutory duty
coded.n: Labor and welfare wings exist in missions in the Gulf and elsewhere by administrative decision; the Act creates no such duty.

coded.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
coded.vl: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
coded.n: Protectors of Emigrants can suspend or cancel an agent's certificate and forfeit the guarantee; compensation needs the courts.

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Pembatasan yang secara tertulis hanya berlaku bagi perempuan (usia minimum lebih tinggi, syarat izin, larangan)
coded.vl: Restrictions whose terms apply to women only (higher minimum ages, consent requirements, bans)
coded.n: Since 2007 women under 30 holding ECR passports are not granted clearance to work in the ECR countries; the rule applies to women only.

coded.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
coded.n: No statutory reintegration duty at the national level; states such as Kerala run reintegration schemes (NORKA).

coded.fn: Departure without sex, age or destination bans
coded.vl: Age floor above 18, family conditions, or bans on some destinations
coded.n: Minimum age 30 for women emigrating for domestic work to countries requiring emigration clearance.

dec.n: People’s Union for Democratic Rights v. Union of India (Asiad workers)
dec.pe: Workers from other states built stadiums in Delhi for the Asian Games and were paid less than the legal minimum. The Supreme Court said paying below the minimum wage is a form of forced labour.
dec.pi: Pekerja dari negara bagian lain membangun stadion di Delhi untuk Asian Games dan dibayar di bawah upah minimum. MA menyatakan membayar di bawah upah minimum adalah bentuk kerja paksa.

dec.n: Labourers Working on Salal Hydro Project v. State of Jammu and Kashmir
dec.pe: Workers from other states building a dam were denied basic labour rights. The Supreme Court ordered the authorities to apply the law that protects workers who migrate between states.
dec.pi: Pekerja dari negara bagian lain yang membangun bendungan tidak mendapat hak dasar. MA memerintahkan otoritas menerapkan UU yang melindungi pekerja yang merantau antarnegara bagian.

dec.n: Bandhua Mukti Morcha v. Union of India
dec.pe: Workers brought from other states to stone quarries near Delhi were trapped by debts. The Supreme Court ordered the government to free them and enforce labour laws.
dec.pi: Pekerja yang didatangkan dari negara bagian lain ke tambang batu dekat Delhi terjerat utang. MA memerintahkan pemerintah membebaskan mereka dan menegakkan hukum ketenagakerjaan.

dec.n: Neeraja Chaudhary v. State of Madhya Pradesh
dec.pe: Workers brought from other states to quarries near Delhi were freed from debt bondage but left with nothing. The Supreme Court said the state must also help them start again.
dec.pi: Pekerja yang dibawa dari negara bagian lain ke tambang batu dekat Delhi dibebaskan dari jeratan utang tetapi dibiarkan tanpa apa-apa. MA menyatakan negara juga wajib membantu mereka memulai lagi.

dec.n: Vishal Jeet v. Union of India
dec.pe: A lawyer asked the Supreme Court to act on girls forced into prostitution, some brought from neighbouring countries. The court told governments to enforce the law and help the girls rebuild their lives.
dec.pi: Seorang advokat meminta MA bertindak terhadap anak perempuan yang dipaksa melacur, sebagian dibawa dari negara tetangga. Pengadilan memerintahkan pemerintah menegakkan hukum dan membantu mereka membangun hidup kembali.

dec.n: Louis De Raedt v. Union of India
dec.pe: Foreign missionaries who had lived in India since before independence were told to leave. The Supreme Court said foreigners have no right to stay, though their lives and liberty are protected.
dec.pi: Misionaris asing yang tinggal di India sejak sebelum kemerdekaan disuruh pergi. MA menyatakan orang asing tidak berhak tinggal, meski hidup dan kebebasannya dilindungi.

dec.n: National Human Rights Commission v. State of Arunachal Pradesh
dec.pe: Chakma families who had lived in Arunachal Pradesh for decades were threatened with being driven out. The Supreme Court ordered the state to protect them and to deal with their citizenship claims.
dec.pi: Keluarga Chakma yang puluhan tahun tinggal di Arunachal Pradesh diancam diusir. MA memerintahkan negara bagian melindungi mereka dan memproses permohonan kewarganegaraan mereka.

dec.n: Chairman, Railway Board v. Chandrima Das
dec.pe: A woman from Bangladesh was raped by railway staff at a station in Kolkata. The Supreme Court said the right to life protects foreigners too and ordered the railways to pay her.
dec.pi: Seorang perempuan dari Bangladesh diperkosa staf kereta api di stasiun Kolkata. MA menyatakan hak hidup juga melindungi orang asing dan memerintahkan perusahaan kereta api membayar ganti rugi.

dec.n: Sarbananda Sonowal v. Union of India
dec.pe: Assam had its own law under which the state had to prove that someone was an illegal migrant. The Supreme Court struck it down, so people now have to prove they are citizens themselves.
dec.pi: Assam punya UU sendiri yang mewajibkan negara membuktikan seseorang migran ilegal. MA membatalkannya, sehingga kini orang harus membuktikan sendiri bahwa mereka warga negara.

dec.n: Bachpan Bachao Andolan v. Union of India (children in circuses)
dec.pe: Children, many of them brought from Nepal, were found working and abused in Indian circuses. The Supreme Court banned child labour in circuses and ordered rescues and rehabilitation.
dec.pi: Anak-anak, banyak yang dibawa dari Nepal, ditemukan bekerja dan dianiaya di sirkus India. MA melarang pekerja anak di sirkus dan memerintahkan penyelamatan dan rehabilitasi.

dec.n: National Campaign Committee for Central Legislation on Construction Labour v. Union of India
dec.pe: India collects a levy on building projects for construction workers, many of them migrants. The Supreme Court found most of the money was not reaching them and ordered the government to register workers and use the funds properly.
dec.pi: India memungut iuran dari proyek bangunan untuk pekerja konstruksi, banyak di antaranya perantau. MA menemukan sebagian besar dana tidak sampai kepada mereka dan memerintahkan pendataan pekerja serta penggunaan dana dengan benar.

dec.n: Mohammad Salimullah v. Union of India
dec.pe: Rohingya refugees detained in Jammu asked the Supreme Court to stop their deportation to Myanmar. The court refused to stop it for now.
dec.pi: Pengungsi Rohingya yang ditahan di Jammu meminta MA menghentikan deportasi mereka ke Myanmar. Pengadilan menolak menghentikannya untuk sementara.

dec.n: In Re: Problems and Miseries of Migrant Labourers
dec.pe: During COVID-19, millions of workers who had moved within India lost their jobs and could not get food rations away from home. The Supreme Court ordered the government to register them and let them use their ration card anywhere in the country.
dec.pi: Selama COVID-19, jutaan pekerja yang merantau di dalam India kehilangan pekerjaan dan tidak bisa mendapat jatah pangan di luar daerah asal. Mahkamah Agung memerintahkan pemerintah mendaftar mereka dan membolehkan kartu jatah pangan dipakai di seluruh negeri.

dec.n: In re Section 6A of the Citizenship Act
dec.pe: Groups in Assam argued that the law giving citizenship to earlier migrants from Bangladesh was unconstitutional. The Supreme Court upheld the law, so those people keep their citizenship.
dec.pi: Kelompok di Assam berpendapat UU yang memberi kewarganegaraan kepada migran awal dari Bangladesh inkonstitusional. MA mempertahankan UU itu, sehingga mereka tetap menjadi warga negara.
